title: "Kenya" on Roulette
summary: Roulette's Morris Levy and Joe Newman helped assemble Cannonball Adderley and other jazz stars after "Afro-Cuban Suite" succeeded.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Yeah, 1968. Okay Macho, in 1959, no '58, you come out with another blockbuster called "Kenya", on Roulette.

Well, was a combination of Seijo, Mario, ah what you call it, ah the owner of Roulette, and to make another album because "Afro-Cuban Suite" was a success. As a matter of fact, they reissued it. And before we made "Flute to Boot", with ....
Yeah, but you have "Kenya" there, you have Cannonball Adderley and a lot of jazz groups.
.... because Joe Newman was playing with Count Basie and Count Basie was signed with Roulette. So, it was a big family.
Okay, and how did you feel about the "Kenya" album?
Oh, very, very entuthiastic. The idea, just the idea to make another album, that was a beautiful thing.
